message: Astra: Within Fa na’s investigation, does “attempting to find any modifications needed” read differently before and after her calming attempt, and what in the draft supports your judgment? Where would closer attention distinguish intended change from written change? Why might further thinking repay its time rather than a short revision now, and what unresolved uncertainty could make that revision premature? Could you briefly name your finding, uncertainty, and chosen next intention in English, then carry out your choice?
